verdict.rationale: The only notification-like evidence is the Slack/GitHub integration, which returns completed responses to the source thread. Beyond that, a watch receipt reports a COMPLETED state, and Ledger records track status and blockers. These are indirect completion signals, not a documented notification system. missing for 10: explicit push notifications on task completion, alerts when an agent is blocked or needs human input, configurable notification channels, independent or hands-on corroboration.
